title: Central audio export settings (config/audio_export.json, optional)
description: Read by the M6 build and the M4 preview (scripts/common/export_config.py). Without the file, global_gain_db defaults to +4 dB and level_mode to global_gain.

global_gain_db.description: Linear gain applied once to every Campaign Evolved replacement before CELT encoding. Never limited: a recording whose peak would pass -1 dBFS gets less (reported).

level_mode.description: How every replacement's level is set. global_gain (default): global_gain_db, linear, never limited. match_spain: each line matched to the loudness of the Spain recording it replaces, look-ahead limiter at -1 dBFS taking at most 6 dB off any peak; the global gain is not used.
